newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,9-,12-mth T-bill yields same,6-mth fall.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,9-,12-mth T-bill yields same,6-mth fall.

text.p: The average yields at auctions of three-, nine- and 12-month treasury bills were unchanged and six-month yields slipped from the last sale on March 11, a central bank statement said on Thursday.
Three-month bills remained at 24.24 percent, six-month bills slipped to 30.15 percent from 30.18 percent, nine-month bills remained at 32.95 percent, and 12-month bills remained at 35.60 percent.
The results of Wednesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 8.00 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Amount sold 7.99 million UAH 4.62 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.54 million UAH 4.36 million UAH
The central bank sold 79,935 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 75,000 were competitive and 4,935 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 13.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 12.00 million UAH 9.80 million UAH
Amount sold 11.94 million UAH 8.17 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.38 million UAH 7.10 million UAH
The central bank sold 119,455 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 89,807 were competitive and 29,648 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 13.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 26.23 million UAH 12.53 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.04 million UAH 10.05 million UAH
The central bank sold 262,290 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 194,380 were competitive and 67,910 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 13.
The results of 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 37.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Amount sold 30.61 million UAH 13.69 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.59 million UAH 10.11 million UAH
The central bank sold 306,062 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 249,042 were competitive and 57,020 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 13.
